title: roadmaps
summary: A personal learning-roadmap repository documenting a self-study ML training curriculum, with a phase-1 markdown lesson on synthetic data generation that walks through building tabular datasets. It demonstrates fitting SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on a seed schema to sample synthetic tabular data, alongside a separate standalone-ctgan example.
needs: Code exists only as illustrative snippets in markdown tutorial docs, not as executed .py files, so it's unclear if it was actually run versus copied for study.
